description: Research-backed evidence registry for peptide -> biomarker response magnitudes. Curated, citation-anchored overrides for the informal defaults in engine/tracking/biomarker_params.py. Each entry records the documented effect magnitude, the evidence GRADE, an explicit relative_sd (uncertainty in the magnitude, as a fraction of the magnitude), and the real, retrieved citations that back it. The loader (engine/tracking/evidence.py) merges these over BIOMARKER_PARAMS; the Bayesian prior (engine/tracking/genetics.derive_prior) uses relative_sd in place of the flat PANEL_REL_SD when an entry exists, so well-studied markers get tighter priors and sparsely-evidenced ones get wider priors. Update this file with engine/tracking/evidence_update.py; never hand-edit a citation you have not actually retrieved.

grade_definitions.A: Multiple human RCTs or a meta-analysis; magnitude well established.
grade_definitions.B: At least one human RCT; magnitude directionally firm but class- or dose-approximate.
grade_definitions.C: Human observational, open-label, or mechanistic-only; direction supported, magnitude soft.
grade_definitions.D: Preclinical only (animal / in vitro); human magnitude is an extrapolation.

Serum IGF-1.rationale: GH-axis secretagogues robustly raise circulating IGF-1 in humans. Tesamorelin's pivotal RCT in HIV-associated lipodystrophy showed a large, sustained IGF-1 rise (roughly a doubling from baseline). Direction is firm from human RCTs; the +55% panel magnitude is a class-level, dose-dependent approximation (hence grade B, not A), so relative_sd is tightened to 0.15 from the 0.20 default but not to the 0.10 A-tier.

Serum VEGF.rationale: BPC-157 promotes angiogenesis and upregulates VEGF/VEGFR2 signaling in animal wound-healing and endothelial models. Evidence is preclinical only; the human serum-VEGF magnitude is an extrapolation, so relative_sd is widened to 0.30 (grade D) rather than the 0.20 default.

citations.title: Stable Gastric Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 and Wound Healing
Body protective compound-157 enhances alkali-burn wound healing in vivo and promotes proliferation, migration, and angiogenesis in vitro

Plasma nitrite/nitrate (NOx).rationale: BPC-157 modulates vasomotor tone via the Src-Caveolin-1-eNOS pathway, raising NO production in endothelial/animal models. Preclinical only; human plasma NOx magnitude is an extrapolation (grade D, relative_sd 0.30).

citations.title: Modulatory effects of BPC 157 on vasomotor tone and the activation of Src-Caveolin-1-endothelial nitric oxide synthase pathway

Serum IGFBP-3.rationale: IGFBP-3 is the principal GH-dependent carrier of circulating IGF-1, so GH-axis secretagogues that raise GH/IGF-1 raise IGFBP-3 in parallel. Supraphysiological GH administration measurably increases the IGF axis including IGFBP-3 in healthy adults (Dall 2000), and an oral GH secretagogue (NN703) stimulated the GH/IGF axis in adults (Svensson 2003). Direction is firm from human data; the specific IGFBP-3 magnitude for these secretagogues is a class-level, dose-dependent inference (grade B, not A), so relative_sd is tightened to 0.15 rather than the 0.10 A-tier.

citations.title: The Effect of Four Weeks of Supraphysiological Growth Hormone Administration on the Insulin-Like Growth Factor Axis in Women and Men
Oral administration of the growth hormone secretagogue NN703 in adult patients with growth hormone deficiency

Lean body mass (DXA).rationale: GH-axis stimulation is anabolic, and the tesamorelin pivotal RCT in HIV-associated lipodystrophy assessed body composition. The trial's primary endpoint was visceral adipose tissue; lean-body-mass / fat-free-mass change is a SECONDARY body-composition endpoint and the effect is small (the panel magnitude is only +5%). That makes the magnitude soft and partly an anabolic-class extrapolation (grade C, relative_sd 0.22), not a firm RCT-derived effect size.

citations.title: Metabolic Effects of a Growth Hormone-Releasing Factor in Patients with HIV

Absolute CD4+ T-lymphocyte count.rationale: Thymosin Alpha-1 promotes T-cell maturation and immune reconstitution. A randomized pilot in HIV patients with low CD4 counts on HAART measured CD4 reconstitution directly (Chadwick 2003), and the multicenter ETASS sepsis RCT showed immune restoration with Tα1 (Wu 2013) — though ETASS's primary immune marker was monocyte HLA-DR rather than absolute CD4 count, so it supports direction more than the CD4-count magnitude. The direct CD4-count evidence is a small pilot and the response is strongly population-dependent (HIV vs sepsis vs healthy), so this is graded C with relative_sd 0.22.

citations.title: A pilot study of the safety and efficacy of thymosin alpha 1 in augmenting immune reconstitution in HIV-infected patients with low CD4 counts taking highly active antiretroviral therapy
The efficacy of thymosin alpha 1 for severe sepsis (ETASS): a multicenter, single-blind, randomized and controlled trial

Body weight (GLP-1 RA).rationale: GLP-1 receptor agonists produce large, sustained weight loss in multiple pivotal RCTs and head-to-head trials: semaglutide 2.4 mg ~15% (STEP program; Wadden 2021 STEP 3), semaglutide vs liraglutide head-to-head (Rubino 2022 STEP 8), and tirzepatide vs semaglutide (Frías 2021 SURPASS-2). Direction and approximate magnitude are firmly established across the class (grade A); the panel magnitude (-13%) is a representative class mean spanning ~8% (liraglutide) to ~21% (tirzepatide), so relative_sd is the tight A-tier 0.10. This is a class-qualified marker that does NOT apply to the generic 'Body weight' marker used by weaker peptides.

HbA1c (GLP-1 RA).rationale: GLP-1 receptor agonists lower HbA1c substantially and consistently across the class, established by a meta-analysis of GLP-1 RA cardiovascular-outcome trials (Bethel 2021) and the tirzepatide-vs-semaglutide SURPASS-2 RCT (Frías 2021), where reductions reach ~1.5-2.0 percentage points. Direction and magnitude are well established (grade A), relative_sd 0.10. Class-qualified marker; does not apply to the generic 'HbA1c' used by weaker metabolic peptides.
